newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Jewish Agency welcomes Swiss envoy resignation.
newsitem.headline: Jewish Agency welcomes Swiss envoy resignation.

text.p: A leading Jewish group campaigning to compensate the families of Holocaust victims for money left in Swiss banks welcomed the resignation on Monday of Switzerland's ambassador to the United States over the affair.
Carlo Jagmetti submitted his resignation on Monday after an internal document he wrote calling for "waging war" against Jewish groups was leaked to the press and triggered uproar.

"This resignation is appropriate and we welcome it," said Jewish Agency Chairman Avraham Burg in a statement. "Anyone who fights the Jewish people today will find himself facing Jewish organisations and leaders who will respond in kind."
"We will not leave a single such remark on the public agenda. Verbal violence leads to incitement, racism and murder. We will excise it from its roots," Burg said.

Jagmetti's comments came from a private strategy paper the envoy sent to Berne last month on how to handle a row over dormant accounts in Swiss banks of Jews murdered by Nazi Germany in World War Two.
Burg received a death threat sent from Switzerland last week over his demand another Swiss official apologise for saying Jews were trying to "blackmail" the Swiss over the bank accounts.
